Day-wise split is rougher than monthly: Amazon credits an ad sale to the click day, while the order report uses the purchase day, so on some days ad sales exceed total sales. Organic is shown as 0 on those days.

Total Amazon sales by product

ProductUnitsSalesShare of sales
Total sales are from the Seller Central order report (Amazon.in orders, cancelled orders and website orders fulfilled by Amazon excluded). Ad sales are what Amazon Ads attributes to ad clicks (7 to 14 day window, can include other Spunge products). Organic = total minus ad sales. Paid orders = Amazon Ads purchases; organic orders = total order report orders minus paid orders (same for units). Amazon doesn't tag single orders as ad or organic, so the split is by count, not order by order. Only days covered by the order report are compared. Paid ROAS = ad sales ÷ ad spend. Organic ROAS = organic sales ÷ ad spend. Blended ROAS = total sales ÷ ad spend. TACoS = ad spend ÷ total sales. The tiles and day-wise table follow the date range; the monthly table and product table always show the full period. The ad product buttons don't apply here.
